text: The glass was much thinner than the picture lads to .... The glass was much thinner than the picture lads to believe. I expected something that might hold a little more if tousled, but I felt if I squeezed it too tightly, the whole bag would snap, and shatter.

product_metadata.title: Genuine Fred UNZIPPED Hand-Blown Glass Bowl
features: FUN AND FUNCTIONAL: This contemporary bowl is shaped like an unzipped disposable plastic bag, with realistically "crinkled" edges and sides. Works great as a candy dish, snack bowl, fish bowl, desk caddy, and more.

UNIQUE DESIGN: Fred's UNZIPPED is the temporary made contemporary. It is designed to celebrate one of those everyday items we take for granted: the zipper bag. Thoughtfully designed, a flat base provides stability on your table or countertop.
QUALITY MATERIALS: Each bowl is crafted from hand-blown borosilicate glass. Top rack dishwasher safe.
VERSATILE SIZE: UNZIPPED measures approximately 5 x 5 x 6 inches and holds 25oz / 740mL

GREAT FOR GIFTING: The perfect gift for your sister, brother, wife, husband, coworker, boss, boyfriend, girlfriend, best friend, friendly acquaintance... Everyone. UNZIPPED comes packed in a full-color, sturdy, giftable box.
description: UNZIPPED by Genuine Fred is designed to celebrate one of those everyday items we take for granted. This contemporary bowl is shaped like an unzipped disposable plastic bag, with realistically "crinkled" edges and sides. Hand-blown borosilicate glass construction ensures durable everyday use and is completely dishwasher safe. A flat base provides stability on your table or countertop. The UNZIPPED bowl comes packaged in a sturdy box for gifting or storage. The bowl measures approximately 5 x 5 x 6 inches.
